purpose: Observe actual pending decision and action/result state at existing failures; preserve new-source complete baseline hash input. No correction or assertion change.

case_names: LEGACY_V0 plays the frozen baseline game exactly as it always has
counter schedules two one-shot triggers for the next turn's upkeep and captures target controller
on the next turn's upkeep target controller may draw 0 to 2 and Denial caster draws one
uncounterable target still gets Arcane Denial's delayed draw abilities
ETB may return a targeted instant from your graveyard
ETB may be declined without returning the targeted card

val diagnosticBefore = _state.toString()
        val diagnosticBeforePendingType = _state.pendingDecision?.javaClass?.name
        val result = processor.process(_state, action).result
        if (result.isSuccess || result.isPaused) {
            _state = result.newState
            _events.addAll(result.events)
        }
        val diagnosticPayload = "action=$action\n" +
            "success=${result.isSuccess} paused=${result.isPaused} error=${result.error}\n" +
            "beforePendingType=$diagnosticBeforePendingType\n" +
            "afterPendingType=${_state.pendingDecision?.javaClass?.name}\n" +
            "before=$diagnosticBefore\n" +
            "resultState=${result.newState}\n" +
            "storedAfter=$_state\n"
        println("IZZET_DECISION_DIAGNOSTIC " + java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(diagnosticPayload.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)))
        return result
